The main weaknesses are unexplained acronyms and jargon (BM25, NPV, pgvector, IP) and year-only dates. Dates also overlap: the postdoc (2022–2026) runs alongside ErythroSIGHT and Accenture (from Jan 2026). That overlap is plausible but never labelled part-time. No hidden or injected content was found.
